name: Philia ni Tsudou Hitsuji-tachi no Uta
original_name: フィリアに集う羊たちの唄
source:
A story of men who possess unique "addictions."

"I'm the worst, what should I do.... I'm a "masturbation addict.""

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE246744.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个关于拥有独特“瘾”的男人的故事。

“我最糟糕了，我该怎么办……我是个‘手淫瘾君子’。”

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE246744.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
